title: Adani Airports chases fast-growing non-aero revenues with latest $300-mn fund raise
summary: Adani Airport Holdings raised ₹2,790 crore from 360 ONE Asset, bringing its external equity funding to ₹12,615 crore. The capital will support airport upgrades, city-side developments, and other non-aero revenues as the operator aims at annual passenger capacity of 200 million at eight airports.
